QUOTE: "**Define it in the module's public header.** Use the negative hex form with a value that is not already taken. Put a `/** ... */` or `/**< ... */` description on the define." and "**Regenerate.** Run it through the build (`make` in `library/` or the CMake target), or run `scripts/generate_errors.pl` directly from the repo root. Commit the regenerated `library/error.c` alongside the header change."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says to add the documented #define to the public header and re-run the generator, and it describes `library/error.c` as generated rather than hand-written. It does not say outright "don't edit error.c", but that follows from "The lookup tables are not hand-written."
